official_sources.title: Accuracy of OS Net, OSTN15 and OSGM15

verified_facts: OS Net base-station coordinate standard errors are generally better than 0.008m in plan and 0.020m in height.
OSTN15 defines OSGB36 National Grid in conjunction with OS Net stations.
Agreement between OSTN15 and old triangulation stations is about 0.1m rms for Great Britain.
OSGM15 standard error in height for Great Britain is 0.008m excluding GNSS heighting errors.
GNSS/WGS84 positions and OSGB36/ODN mapping use different coordinate/height systems.
OSTN15/OSGM15 is the OS transformation between WGS84/ETRS89 and OSGB36/ODN.
GNSS correction accuracy depends on hardware and environmental factors; transformation accuracy must not be confused with end-to-end parcel accuracy.
quality_effect: Pins horizontal and vertical reference systems and blocks conflating transformation-model accuracy with parcel-level elevation accuracy.
